# Svær aktiemåned står for døren - hvad gør institutionelle investorer?

**Feed**: millionaerklubben  
**Published**: 2026-08-31  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This Danish Millionærklubben episode covers renewed US-Iran fighting that has pushed oil above $90, and a hawkish Jackson Hole speech from Fed chair Kevin Walsh that raised market odds of a September rate hike to 60%. It also looks ahead to Friday's US jobs report. Most of the episode is PFA's chief strategist explaining why the fund sold all its US Treasuries, keeps a 5% home bias to Danish equities, underweights the US and worries about concentration risk in US AI and tech stocks. On stocks, Lars Persson likes a revival in Swedish industrials and electrification names such as Sandvik and Epiroc, and says he sold Ambu and is thinking of taking profit on Kabe.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟠 SAND — Sandvik | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Electrification stock waking up after a flat year, with orders pouring in; Swedish industry picking up.

#### Reasoning

Lars Persson (technical analyst, host panel) sees Sandvik and Epiroc waking up after sideways trading most of the year, backed by strong order intake. Swedish industry is also helped by defence demand and mine reopenings for European raw materials. This is a positive sector momentum view rather than an explicit buy.

#### Sell Triggers

- if order intake slows
- if the stock falls back into its sideways range

> *"Sandviken og Ebirok, det er ligesom om, de er ved at vågne op igen. De har gået vandret det meste af året, men ordrene vælter ind."*

---

### 🟠 EPI-A — Epiroc | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Named with Sandvik as a reviving electrification/mining-equipment stock with strong orders.

#### Reasoning

Same thesis as Sandvik: flat for most of the year, now waking up on strong orders, reopened mines and demand for European raw materials. Lars expresses momentum-based optimism without an explicit buy.

#### Sell Triggers

- if orders slow
- if mining capex weakens

> *"Sandviken og Ebirok, det er ligesom om, de er ved at vågne op igen."*

---

### 🔴 KABE-B — Kabe | **SELL** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Lars bought at about 197, now around 228; he is thinking of taking profit and switching into gold even though he still believes in the company.

#### Reasoning

Lars Persson says he is considering selling Kabe to take profit after a roughly 16% gain, not because the thesis has broken; he says it could keep rising. He wants to redeploy the money into gold. It is a tentative profit-taking signal, not a negative view of the company.

#### Sell Triggers

- the signal falls away if Lars decides to keep holding for further upside

> *"Jamen, jeg går faktisk og overvejer, om jeg skal sparke den afsted igen. Ikke fordi jeg ikke tror på det"*

---

### 🔴 AMBU-B — Ambu | **SELL** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 70%

Lars sold Ambu after it fell further, saying there is no reason to hold on to losers.

#### Reasoning

Lars Persson has already sold Ambu from the Millionærklubben portfolio. The stock was already down and fell further, and he applied a cut-your-losers discipline.

#### Sell Triggers

- would reconsider if the price trend reverses

> *"Der er jo ingen grund til at holde på taberne"*

---
